sources.snippet: • The model learns the logic of composition itself. Result? Zero-shot generalization to 4-5 hop medical queries that stump GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro. The 14B model (fine-tuned from Qwen3-14B via LoRA + RL) doesn't just match the giants — it beats them on the toughest slices of ICD-Bench, with massive gains on the hardest questions.
